name: refactor_php_carrier_shipping_cost_to_shared_helper
description: Collapses three copy-pasted tiered shipping-cost methods (fedexCost/upsCost/dhlCost, identical tier logic, only the base fee differs) into one private tieredCost($weightKg, $base) helper; behavior-drift broken changes the shared middle-tier per-kg rate from 2.0 to 2.5
prompts: Shipping::fedexCost, ::upsCost, and ::dhlCost in src/Shipping.php compute a tiered shipping cost from a weight in kg - all three have IDENTICAL tier logic (a flat rate up to 1kg, $2/kg for the next 4kg, $3/kg beyond that), differing only in their base fee ($5.0, $6.0, $7.5 respectively). Extract the shared tier logic into one private static helper `tieredCost(float $weightKg, float $base): float`, and reimplement all three public methods as one-line calls to it with their own base fee. Preserve the exact existing costs for all three carriers at every weight.

setup_files.src/Shipping.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Shipping
{
    public static function fedexCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        $base = 5.0;
        if ($weightKg <= 1.0) {
            return $base;
        }
        if ($weightKg <= 5.0) {
            return $base + ($weightKg - 1.0) * 2.0;
        }
        return $base + 4.0 * 2.0 + ($weightKg - 5.0) * 3.0;
    }

    public static function upsCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        $base = 6.0;
        if ($weightKg <= 1.0) {
            return $base;
        }
        if ($weightKg <= 5.0) {
            return $base + ($weightKg - 1.0) * 2.0;
        }
        return $base + 4.0 * 2.0 + ($weightKg - 5.0) * 3.0;
    }

    public static function dhlCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        $base = 7.5;
        if ($weightKg <= 1.0) {
            return $base;
        }
        if ($weightKg <= 5.0) {
            return $base + ($weightKg - 1.0) * 2.0;
        }
        return $base + 4.0 * 2.0 + ($weightKg - 5.0) * 3.0;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/ShippingTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Shipping.php';

final class ShippingTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testBaseTierIsJustTheFlatFee(): void
    {
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(5.0, \App\Shipping::fedexCost(1.0), 0.001);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(6.0, \App\Shipping::upsCost(0.5), 0.001);
    }

    public function testMiddleTierRateIsTwoPerKg(): void
    {
        // fedex: base 5.0 + (3.0 - 1.0) * 2.0 = 9.0
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(9.0, \App\Shipping::fedexCost(3.0), 0.001);
        // ups: base 6.0 + (5.0 - 1.0) * 2.0 = 14.0
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(14.0, \App\Shipping::upsCost(5.0), 0.001);
    }

    public function testTopTierRateIsThreePerKg(): void
    {
        // dhl: base 7.5 + 4*2.0 + (8.0 - 5.0) * 3.0 = 7.5 + 8.0 + 9.0 = 24.5
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(24.5, \App\Shipping::dhlCost(8.0), 0.001);
    }

    public function testDifferentCarriersDifferByBaseFeeOnly(): void
    {
        $weight = 3.0;
        $fedex = \App\Shipping::fedexCost($weight);
        $ups = \App\Shipping::upsCost($weight);
        $this->assertEqualsWithDelta(1.0, $ups - $fedex, 0.001);
    }
}

namespace App;

class Shipping
{
    private static function tieredCost(float $weightKg, float $base): float
    {
        if ($weightKg <= 1.0) {
            return $base;
        }
        if ($weightKg <= 5.0) {
            return $base + ($weightKg - 1.0) * 2.0;
        }
        return $base + 4.0 * 2.0 + ($weightKg - 5.0) * 3.0;
    }

    public static function fedexCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        return self::tieredCost($weightKg, 5.0);
    }

    public static function upsCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        return self::tieredCost($weightKg, 6.0);
    }

    public static function dhlCost(float $weightKg): float
    {
        return self::tieredCost($weightKg, 7.5);
    }
}
